chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0452: Ji Ning's Raw Power vs. Five Celestial Immortals
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers the Shaoyin clan's ultimate treasure and begins to pull it free. Five Celestial Immortals cannot stop him, forcing their Ancestor to intervene.

og_description: Ji Ning discovers the Shaoyin clan's ultimate treasure and begins to pull it free. Five Celestial Immortals cannot stop him, forcing their Ancestor to intervene.
twitter_title: The Endless Cupping Furnace is Ji Ning's next target!
twitter_description: Ji Ning's raw strength overwhelms five Celestial Immortals as he tries to unearth a mysterious ancient artifact.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level spatial movement technique that allows a cultivator to instantly travel across vast distances, often used by Celestial Immortals and above. It can be blocked or sealed by powerful formations or divine sense.
An ancient, mysterious artifact buried beneath the Shaoyin clan's ancestral domain. It is considered a pillar of the clan's power, along with its Celestial Immortals.
A formation technique used by the five Celestial Immortals to bind and capture Ji Ning, which proved insufficient against his raw power.

A classification of magic treasure at the very peak of the Pure Yang grade, considered the highest tier of artifact before the legendary Immortal-grade treasures. They are immensely powerful and rare.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the five Celestial Immortals stop Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning has reached the fifth cycle of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art, making his body virtually indestructible. Furthermore, his fourth-cycle Starseizing Hand grants him monstrous physical strength, allowing him to overpower all five of them combined.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Endless Cupping Furnace?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is an ancient artifact buried deep beneath the Shaoyin clan's domain, considered by the clan to be as important as their Celestial Immortals. Its full nature is a closely guarded secret.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the "Ancestor" of the Shaoyin clan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is a single-horned humanoid being of immense power, the ultimate trump card and the true founder of the Shaoyin clan. His arrival at the end of the chapter signals a massive escalation in the conflict.
